product: Svipall is a local Rust binary that hands an agent the page, or the exact verdict of the wall that refused it.

rules.assert: No GitHub star, fork, watcher or download counter is rendered.
Nothing offers to run Svipall in the browser.
Every number resolves to a truth-ledger row and carries its method.
This build is a persuade surface; gate 7 runs interface-audit.md; gate 6 scores five criteria.
The home contains exactly the eight declared plain-language sections, in order.
One primary CTA to docs/install.md, one lighter secondary to /docs/proof, no third.
Radius is 0, 2px or 50%; 50% binds to the status lamp alone; no pill exists.
Exactly one box-shadow exists, bound to dialog and menu.
Semantic colour appears only where a state is reported, never as decoration.
The neutral leans cool, away from the accent: a neutral warmed toward yellow is the cream the author banned.
Display and prose are Archivo; Commit Mono is bound to the underlayer, values, apertures, panel legends and section 7 code.
Nothing rests at opacity 0 waiting for an observer; no entrance is scroll-driven.
The one orchestrated moment is the hero demonstration replay; section 2 lamps are static; the full transcript is in the HTML at rest.
All eighteen contrast pairs meet AA in both themes; APCA reported separately.
Measure stays within 45-75ch in both density settings.
No rune, knotwork background, horn, raven, parchment or saga lettering appears.
No sparkle, wand or violet AI gradient appears; copy does not anthropomorphise the agent.
No phosphor green, glitch, skull, code rain or scanline appears.
The mark renders monochrome with the accent only on the eye.
No original brand hex appears as a literal in the site source.
Every token is declared in bare :root before any theme block redefines it.
The one aesthetic risk is the section 2 before-and-after as two facing annunciator panels, and nowhere else.
An unlit lamp stays legible: its label meets the UI contrast target.
Home copy is second person with no exclamation mark; docs copy keeps source hedges.
No claim of guaranteed success against any anti-bot vendor appears.
Zero MUST violations in the interface audit.
Sections 1-6 contain no jargon: tier, MCP, server, JSON, HTTP, API, CLI, endpoint, header, status code, crate, binary, Rust, headless, stealth, fingerprint.
The six tier names appear nowhere on the home.
No confidence index, trust score, or wording implying Svipall ranks or filters pages by trustworthiness.
Any mention of percentiles carries its stated limit: none below 30 local observations, not validated intervals.
Every claim on the without-Svipall side of the comparison is sourced and as defensible as the Svipall side.
The macrostructure is demonstration-first; the docs surface uses reference.
The idiom is cell grid: a page of drawn rules, present in the nav, the bands, the cells and the controls.
Every block is a cell with a drawn 1px edge; nothing has a fill without an edge and nothing has a shadow.
The accent is fill only: at most two mark highlights per band; exactly one accent fill is a control.
No backdrop-filter, no blur and no translucent surface exists anywhere in the project.
Border widths are exactly 1px, for every grid rule, and 2px, for the focus ring alone.
A shadow means this can be closed: one value, bound to menus. A cell never casts one.
Every band opens with a two-digit number and a mono label in the same corner; never inside a cell or on a control.
Only the declared primitives are built: Row, Cell, Terminal, Clients, InstallBlock with its two-way switch, Panel, Lamp, Nav, ThemeToggle, Mark.
Every section is flush left on one rail at every breakpoint; nothing is centred.
Commit Mono never sets a heading; Archivo sets everything a person reads, including the hero.
No radial glow, no coloured box-shadow, no backdrop-filter over a flat colour.
The palette is exactly the fourteen declared hexes plus the declared rgba compositions. A third-party mark may keep one brand hex, bound to the element showing it and never reused.
The accent never sets text. Links are ink with a rule; the accent is the CTA fill and nothing else in the first screen.
The hero demonstration carries its not-a-recording caption in view and contains no figure of any kind.

Third-party marks appear only in the section 1 strip, only as official downloaded files, under a label stating the MCP mechanism rather than tested support or endorsement. Every named client supports MCP. No company marks, only tools.

rules.source: gate 5, widened gate 6 — FAILING by author direction
rules.assert: Autoplaying motion beyond five seconds carries a way to stop it. The client strip carries none: the visible control was removed at gate 5 and pause on hover at gate 6, both at the author's direction. Only prefers-reduced-motion remains, and :focus-within went with the hover rule because nothing in the belt can take focus, so it could never have matched.

The palette is derived from the logo: navy ground, bone-warm ink, amber accent, rust as the blocked signal. Bone is excluded as a light ground (1.15:1) and caution moved off amber to avoid two ambers with different meanings.
A change between two views of the same thing transitions rather than cuts; indicators move with transform, never with layout properties.

idiom.name: cell grid
idiom.from: a ruled board of cells; pinned by the brief's own reference from the first message

nonNegotiables.claim: Every block is a cell with a drawn 1px edge. Nothing carries a fill without an edge, and nothing carries a shadow.
nonNegotiables.proof: Every block in a capture is bounded by a visible rule; nothing reads as floating.

nonNegotiables.claim: The accent is fill only: at most two mark highlights per band, and exactly one accent fill on the page is a control. Highlights mark; only the call to action acts.
nonNegotiables.proof: The yellow on screen is the CTA bar plus at most two highlighted phrases.

nonNegotiables.claim: Every band carries a two-digit number and a mono label in the same corner, and the numbering is the real section order.
nonNegotiables.proof: Each band opens with NN / LABEL at top left.

signature.what: the numbered band header: NN / LABEL in Commit Mono, small and tracked, in the same corner of every band
signature.recurs: once per Row, at least once per section; never inside a Cell, on a control, or in the nav
